incident-bot: [INCIDENT] GPU pool us-east-2a: capacity_exhausted for pool `inference-prod-gpu-pool-2` — queue growth detected, autoscaler requests failing. Pager: @Jamie.

Jamie (oncall): seeing the page, jumping in. who has the latest dashboard link?

Lee (sre): dashboards show queue depth 28k requests in the pool, avg latency for generation 8.2s, 429 rate 12% for tenant routing. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts: provider error 403 QuotaExceeded + several 429s from provider API.

Swati (eng-runtime): looks like spike originated from tenant `tracklytics` — sudden burst of long-context jobs. They blew past our per-tenant soft limits. autoscaler hit configured scale limit (max_nodes=40) in region, attempted more but controller capping.

Jamie (oncall): customer impact? which tenants are affected?

Mike (support): Support queue: ~6 incoming severity-high tickets complaining about timeouts and 429s; two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, Zeno Labs) reported degraded responses to production users. status page flagged as "degraded" by the incident bot.

Erin (product): any workaround we can tell customers short-term? message templates?

Jamie (oncall): immediate mitigations I can run: 1) enable route-level throttling for non-enterprise tenants, 2) flip traffic for AcmeCorp -> eu-west fallback if acceptable, 3) temporarily scale dedicated pool (if PJ approves), 4) attempt manual provider scale (request additional nodes). Thoughts?

Swati (eng-runtime): do (1) and (2) now. I can push a quick admission-control rule to throttle any tenant > 250 concurrent tokens. Also enable fallback-model routing for long-context jobs to a quantized variant (lower mem) to reduce GPU reservation.

Lee (sre): I'll attempt manual scale via cloud provider UI but expect provider quota error. also increasing eviction aggressiveness on that pool to free slots (evict low-priority jobs). running eviction script now:

```
# eviction run
kubectl exec -n inference autoscaler-ctrl -- /bin/sh -c "python tools/evict.py --pool inference-prod-gpu-pool-2 --score eviction_score"
```

Jamie (oncall): sending support note to affected customers: "We're experiencing capacity pressure in us-east-2a; we have mitigations active and will follow up with ETA. No data loss; degraded latency/429s possible." pinging @Erin for wording.

Erin (product): ack, add phone PD for AcmeCorp. use template: "We are actively mitigating a capacity event impacting some requests; our engineering team is prioritizing your traffic."

Mike (support): posted messages to AcmeCorp and Zeno support threads. Acme asked for temporary route to eu-west if it doesn't break latency — they prefer availability.

Swati (eng-runtime): rolled admission control and fallback-model routing. early telemetry: queue dropping rate halved, 429s down to ~6% and tail latency for priority tenants improved. still showing autoscaler retries failing.

Lee (sre): provider quota confirmed: account reached GPU quota for us-east-2a (requested increase pending). provider rejected scale requests with 403: QuotaExceeded. Filed support ticket with provider; no ETA.

Jamie (oncall): next steps: 1) keep admission control live, 2) maintain eviction aggressive for 15m window, 3) route enterprise tenants to fallback region if they opt-in, 4) SRE to continue manual free-up and monitor. Can we request burst capacity from dedicated pool?

Swati (eng-runtime): Dedicated pool has spare capacity in us-east-1; we can migrate traffic for eligible tenants. I'll prepare a scripted route switch for AcmeCorp and Zeno.

Lee (sre): manual eviction freed ~8 nodes after first pass, queue dropped to 9k; 429s down to 3.7%. autoscaler still logging repeated backoff because it hit max_nodes setting — need to bump config to allow emergency scale above 40 for this pool.

Jamie (oncall): can someone with config perms bump max_nodes? This is an emergency change.

Swati (eng-runtime): I can patch the pool config to max_nodes=60 for emergency. deploying now.

incident-bot: [CHANGE] pool config updated by Swati: max_nodes 40 -> 60 (emergency). Audit: changelist CL-4579.

Lee (sre): autoscaler resumed and provider accepted a second batch request — new nodes provisioning. queue trending down to 3.2k.

Jamie (oncall): good work. what's the customer impact now?

Mike (support): Acme switched to eu-west; back to green on their side. Zeno still seeing elevated latencies but within SLA after fallback-model. open tickets updated.

Erin (product): we'll send an incident summary and targeted note to affected customers in 2h. Also want to schedule a postmortem with eng-runtime + SRE + product + support.

Swati (eng-runtime): immediate action items: 1) add per-tenant burst protection (rate-limit + token bucket) with default thresholds, owner: Swati, due 2 weeks; 2) add a hard cap and circuit-breaker for very long-context jobs, owner: Swati, due 3 weeks.

Lee (sre): SRE action items: 1) add metric for autoscaler rejection reasons (QuotaExceeded, RateLimited) in dashboards, owner: Lee, due 1 week; 2) update runbook to include emergency bump procedure and who can approve, owner: Lee, due 3 days; 3) automate eviction scoring so manual runs aren't needed, owner: Lee & Swati, due 4 weeks.

Jamie (oncall): cross-org actions: 1) request permanent provider quota increase (PM + infra), owner: Erin, due 5 days; 2) add alert that triggers at queue depth 5k with customer-impact tag, owner: product ops, due 1 week.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] status -> mitigated. root cause summary: tenant spillover causing sustained long-context jobs; autoscaler hit configured scale limit and provider quota; manual eviction + emergency max_nodes bump + routing fallbacks mitigated impact.

Mike (support): created external post-incident message draft, will wait for product review.

Erin (product): scheduling postmortem meeting for Tue 10:00am PT, invite eng-runtime, SRE, support, and sales for customer comms.

Jamie (oncall): final note before I hand back to rotation: if anything regresses, page SRE channel and tag me. great cross-team response. :thumbsup:

Swati (eng-runtime): leaving a snippet of the autoscaler error for the postmortem:

```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z autoscaler ERROR scale_request failed: provider_response={"code":403,"message":"QuotaExceeded: GPU quota exhausted in region us-east-2a"}
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z autoscaler WARN backoff scheduling retry in 120s
```

Lee (sre): saving logs and creating incident doc link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3187654321.

incident-bot: thread closed by Jamie (oncall) at 3187654821."
